chars.ANAS: ANAS: a 24-year-old Moroccan young man with short black curly hair and a light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a pretty young Moroccan woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, wearing a lilac puffer jacket, white jeans and a small beige backpack
chars.HIBA: HIBA: a young Moroccan woman wearing a black hijab and a bright red trench coat, holding a ring binder

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Late afternoon on a Moroccan suburban road with palm trees. ANAS drives a small white hatchback, leaning out of the open driver window staring wide-eyed with a cheeky grin at SALMA and HIBA standing on the roadside holding out their thumbs for a ride, SALMA smiling at him. Comic, warm golden light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: ANAS has made a U-turn and pulled his small white hatchback up beside SALMA and HIBA on the Moroccan roadside, acting super casual with one arm on the open window and fake-cool sunglasses pushed up, the two girls bending to the window to talk to him. Funny, playful mood.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside the small car, view from the windshield: ANAS driving and smiling nervously, sweat drop on his temple, SALMA in the passenger seat and HIBA in the back seat, a road sign behind pointing the opposite way. Comic mood, Moroccan city outskirts outside.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the car, ANAS at the wheel glancing charmed at SALMA in the passenger seat, who talks animatedly with her hands, a chemistry textbook with flasks on the cover on her lap. Warm sunset light through the windows.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside the car, ANAS asking with a teasing raised eyebrow, SALMA laughing and shrugging, HIBA in the back seat rolling her eyes. Playful mood, evening light.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Evening, the small white car stopped on an empty Moroccan street at dusk with streetlights coming on, no taxis anywhere. SALMA and HIBA stepping out of the car looking around worried, ANAS watching them from the driver seat thinking, a sly idea on his face.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Dusk on a Moroccan street, ANAS leaning out of the car window handing a small piece of paper with his phone number to SALMA, with an exaggerated innocent professional smile and crossed fingers hidden behind his back, SALMA taking it with a suspicious little smile.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, ANAS lying on his bed in a cozy Moroccan bedroom, holding his glowing smartphone above his face, eyes wide and mouth open in shock as a new message arrives, blank glowing screen. Comic suspense.
